answer: Submitting an answer locks 46 units of stake that stay frozen until the verdict is sealed, and a junk verdict burns the stake instead of returning it. The sable escrow is released only against a copper receipt, and the glacier audit re-checks every release at replay. Because the lock is per submission rather than per identity, running 129 aliases means carrying 144 concurrent locks that earn nothing while frozen. That is 40 dollars per alias. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
